observations: Multiple used car engine blocks and transmission units are shown in a workshop or garage.
The engines appear heavily used, dusty, and dirty.
A yellow label is visible on the side of the transmission unit in the center.
The engine in the foreground has a large black intake manifold and a visible exhaust pipe.
The background shows other engine components and a wall with red graffiti.
The image is a single, static photo taken in a low-light environment.

claims.claim: never buy an item because it's cheap, cause you might not...

risks.risk: The engine may not be rebuilt or refurbished.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's technical specification plate (usually on the engine block).
risks.if_unproven: as a used engine with no refurbishment

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing or in poor condition.
risks.proof: A photo of the transmission unit with its own specification plate.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or high compression.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's technical specification plate.
Photo of the transmission unit with its own specification plate.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
